scripts.dev:predictions: set "PATH=%SystemRoot%\System32;%PATH%" && concurrently --names "USER,ML" "npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort" "npm run ml:server"
scripts.dev:all: %SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\stopDevServers.ps1 && set "PATH=%SystemRoot%\System32;%PATH%" && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "USER,ADMIN,NODE,ML" "npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort" "npm run dev -- --port 5174 --strictPort --mode admin" "npm run server" "npm run ml:server"
scripts.server:mock: set "MOCK_GEMINI_RESPONSE=**Mocked health guidance:** This deterministic response is for automated testing only." && set "MOCK_REPORT_ANALYSIS=true" && node --experimental-strip-types server.ts
scripts.server:mock:test: set "PORT=3001" && set "MOCK_GEMINI_RESPONSE=**Mocked health guidance:** This deterministic response is for automated testing only." && set "MOCK_REPORT_ANALYSIS=true" && node --experimental-strip-types server.ts
scripts.dev:test: %SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\stopTestServers.ps1 && set "PATH=%SystemRoot%\System32;%PATH%" && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "USER,ADMIN,NODE,ML" "set VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3001&& set VITE_ML_API_URL=http://localhost:8001&& npm run dev -- --port 5175 --strictPort" "set VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3001&& set VITE_ML_API_URL=http://localhost:8001&& npm run dev -- --port 5176 --strictPort --mode admin" "npm run server:mock:test" "npm run ml:test"
scripts.ml:train: cd ml_backend && .python-runtime\python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from disease_prediction.train import main; main()"
scripts.ml:train-risk: cd ml_backend && .python-runtime\python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from risk_prediction.train import main; main()"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:ml && npm run build
